verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

segments.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

verses.text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

segments.text: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

verses.text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

segments.text: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.text: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.

segments.text: They have no struggle in their death; their bodies are well-fed.

verses.text: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.

segments.text: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.

verses.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.

segments.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence covers them.

verses.text: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.

segments.text: From their prosperity proceeds iniquity; the imaginations of their hearts run wild.

verses.text: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

segments.text: They mock and speak with malice; with arrogance they threaten oppression.

verses.text: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.

segments.text: They set their mouths against the heavens, and their tongues strut across the earth.

verses.text: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.

segments.text: So their people return to this place and drink up waters in abundance.

verses.text: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

segments.text: The wicked say, “How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?”

verses.text: Behold, these are the wicked—always carefree as they increase their wealth.

segments.text: Behold, these are the wicked—always carefree as they increase their wealth.

verses.text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

segments.text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.

verses.text: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

segments.text: For I am afflicted all day long and punished every morning.

verses.text: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.

segments.text: If I had said, “I will speak this way,” then I would have betrayed Your children.

verses.text: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight

segments.text: When I tried to understand all this, it was troublesome in my sight

verses.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.

segments.text: until I entered God’s sanctuary; then I discerned their end.

verses.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.

segments.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You cast them down into ruin.

verses.text: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!

segments.text: How suddenly they are laid waste, completely swept away by terrors!

verses.text: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.

segments.text: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.

verses.text: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,

segments.text: When my heart was grieved and I was pierced within,

verses.text: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

segments.text: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

verses.text: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.

segments.text: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.

verses.text: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

segments.text: You guide me with Your counsel, and later receive me in glory.

verses.text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.

segments.text: Whom have I in heaven but You? And on earth I desire no one besides You.

verses.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

segments.text: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.text: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

segments.text: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.

verses.text: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.

segments.text: But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
